reason: Folding the 4.31.1 machine output into the preserved 4.3.0 tree needed small compat shims: SQLite write-lock helpers the refreshed store candidates.go calls, a no-op MCP profile bind (api-key CLI registers no platform source), ported writeDryRun/parentNoSubcommandRunE/responsePayloadAtPath helpers, EscapePathParam, new rootFlags fields plus --no-learn, and export call-site adaptation to the preserved client signatures. Fresh platform tenant-gating files (platform_client.go, platform_window.go, mcp/platform_gate.go and their tests) were removed as inapplicable to api-key auth; the MCP entry point itself ships. 4.31.7 reprint: the write-lock and profile-bind shims were retired (generator now ships the hardened store locking and the api-key CLI needs no platform bind); remaining ports (helpers, root flags, export call-sites, text utils) carried forward.
summary: Compat shims porting template helpers into the preserved tree; inapplicable platform-gating files removed; 4.31.7 reprint retired the write-lock and profile-bind shims.
validated_outcome: Merged-tree go build passes; go vet and go test -count=1 ./... re-run at publish time.
